// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

// Get a free hosted Postgres database in seconds: `npx create-db`

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client"
  output   = "../src/generated/prisma"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
}

model User {
  id                     String                @id @default(uuid())
  email                  String                @unique
  name                   String?
  encryptedRefreshToken  String?
  googleId               String?               @unique
  gmailScopes            String[]              @default([])
  gmailSendOnlyConsentAt DateTime?
  gmailAuthorized        Boolean               @default(false)
  preferredRoles         String[]              @default([])
  deletionRequestedAt    DateTime?
  followUpDays           Int                   @default(7)
  gmailPauseReason       GmailPauseReason?
  gmailPauseUntil        DateTime?
  nextSendAt             DateTime?
  currentAttachmentId    String?
  createdAt              DateTime              @default(now())
  templates              Template[]
  contacts               Contact[]
  campaigns              Campaign[]
  attachments            Attachment[]
  deliveryReceipts       DeliveryReceipt[]
  usagePeriods           UsagePeriod[]
  usageReservations      UsageReservation[]
  usageImportEvidence    UsageImportEvidence[]
  usageBackfillVersion   Int                   @default(0)
  usageCutoverAt         DateTime?
  testingUsageResetAt    DateTime?

  plan                  Plan                  @default(FREE)
  subscriptionStatus    SubscriptionStatus    @default(NONE)
  currentPeriodStart    DateTime?
  currentPeriodEnd      DateTime?
  dodoCustomerId        String?               @unique
  dodoSubscriptionId    String?               @unique
  cancelAtPeriodEnd     Boolean               @default(false)
  gracePeriodEnd        DateTime?
  billingCountry        String?
  billingCurrency       String?
  billingStateVersion   Int                   @default(0)
  lastBillingEventAt    DateTime?
  planOverride          Plan?
  planOverrideStartsAt  DateTime?
  planOverrideExpiresAt DateTime?
  planOverrideReason    String?
  grandfatheredUntil    DateTime?
  freeTemplateId        String?
  isAdmin               Boolean               @default(false)
  isSuspended           Boolean               @default(false)
  suspendedAt           DateTime?
  suspensionReason      String?
  lastActiveAt          DateTime?
  accountNotices        AccountNotice[]
  billingRateLimits     BillingRateLimit[]
  subscriptions         BillingSubscription[]
  checkoutAttempts      CheckoutAttempt[]
  adminActions          AdminAuditLog[]       @relation("AdminActor")
  adminTargetActions    AdminAuditLog[]       @relation("AdminTarget")

  @@index([plan, subscriptionStatus, createdAt, id])
  @@index([isSuspended, createdAt, id])
  @@index([currentPeriodEnd])
  @@index([gracePeriodEnd])
  @@index([lastActiveAt])
}

model Template {
  id         String     @id @default(uuid())
  userId     String
  name       String
  subject    String
  body       String
  archivedAt DateTime?
  createdAt  DateTime   @default(now())
  user       User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  campaigns  Campaign[]

  @@index([userId])
}

model Contact {
  id                  String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId              String
  name                String
  email               String
  company             String?
  jobRole             String?
  notes               String?
  tag                 String?
  archivedAt          DateTime?
  shortlistRemovedAt  DateTime?
  followUpRequestedAt DateTime?
  createdAt           DateTime  @default(now())
  user                User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  sends               Send[]

  @@unique([userId, email])
  @@index([userId])
}

model Campaign {
  id                     String      @id @default(uuid())
  userId                 String
  templateId             String
  status                 String
  role                   String      @default("")
  idempotencyKey         String?
  approvedRecipientCount Int         @default(0)
  usesCustomRole         Boolean     @default(false)
  usesRepeatSend         Boolean     @default(false)
  attachmentId           String?
  attachment             Attachment? @relation(fields: [attachmentId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  createdAt              DateTime    @default(now())
  user                   User        @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  template               Template    @relation(fields: [templateId], references: [id])
  sends                  Send[]

  @@unique([userId, idempotencyKey])
  @@index([userId])
}

// Content-free notices survive removal of campaign history.
model AccountNotice {
  id                 String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId             String
  deduplicationKey   String
  campaignIdSnapshot String
  reasonCode         String
  cancelledCount     Int
  createdAt          DateTime  @default(now())
  dismissedAt        DateTime?
  user               User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, deduplicationKey])
  @@index([userId, dismissedAt, createdAt])
}

// Independent recovery/tombstone: deliberately has no foreign key to User.
model AccountDeletionJob {
  id                         String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId                     String    @unique
  googleSubjectHash          String?   @unique
  requestedAt                DateTime
  credentialExpiresAt        DateTime
  encryptedRevocationToken   String?
  googleRevokedAt            DateTime?
  credentialErasedAt         DateTime?
  googleRevocationIncomplete Boolean   @default(false)
  contentDeletedAt           DateTime?
  storageDeletedAt           DateTime?
  billingCancelledAt         DateTime?
  completedAt                DateTime?
  customerIds                String[]  @default([])
  subscriptionIds            String[]  @default([])
  checkoutRecovery           Json      @default("[]")
  billingRequired            Boolean   @default(false)
  billingRecoveryVersion     Int       @default(0)
  cancellationAttempts       Int       @default(0)
  cancellationFailures       Int       @default(0)
  nextBillingAttemptAt       DateTime  @default(now())
  nextAttemptAt              DateTime  @default(now())
  leaseToken                 String?
  leaseExpiresAt             DateTime?
  failureCode                String?
  purgeFailureCode           String?
  createdAt                  DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt                  DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@index([completedAt, nextAttemptAt, id])
}

model Send {
  historyDeletedAt        DateTime?
  createdAt               DateTime          @default(now())
  recipientEmail          String            @default("")
  recipientName           String            @default("")
  recipientRole           String            @default("")
  recipientCompany        String            @default("")
  templateName            String            @default("")
  subject                 String            @default("")
  body                    String            @default("")
  mimeMessageId           String?           @unique
  deliveryState           DeliveryState     @default(READY)
  attemptedAt             DateTime?
  availableAt             DateTime?
  queueExpiresAt          DateTime?
  claimToken              String?
  leaseExpiresAt          DateTime?
  dispatchGeneration      Int               @default(0)
  dispatchAttempts        Int               @default(0)
  preparationRetries      Int               @default(0)
  credentialRetries       Int               @default(0)
  throttleRetries         Int               @default(0)
  dispatchAttemptedAt     DateTime?
  usageReservation        UsageReservation?
  dispatchedAt            DateTime?
  lastCheckedAt           DateTime?
  replyMarkedAt           DateTime?
  bouncedAt               DateTime?
  sentConfirmedManuallyAt DateTime?

  id             String     @id @default(uuid())
  campaignId     String
  contactId      String
  status         SendStatus @default(QUEUED)
  cancelledAt    DateTime?
  sentAt         DateTime?
  gmailMessageId String?
  gmailThreadId  String?
  error          String?
  campaign       Campaign   @relation(fields: [campaignId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  contact        Contact    @relation(fields: [contactId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([campaignId])
  @@index([contactId])
  @@index([status, sentAt])
  @@index([status, deliveryState, availableAt])
  @@index([deliveryState, leaseExpiresAt])
  @@index([status, queueExpiresAt])
  @@index([deliveryState, attemptedAt, id])
  @@index([deliveryState, createdAt, id])
}

model Attachment {
  rejectedAt       DateTime?
  deletedAt        DateTime?
  storageDeletedAt DateTime?
  id               String     @id @default(uuid())
  userId           String
  fileName         String
  createdAt        DateTime   @default(now())
  campaigns        Campaign[]
  storagePath      String
  user             User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([userId, storageDeletedAt, createdAt, id])
}

enum SendStatus {
  QUEUED
  CANCELLED
  SENT
  FAILED
  REPLIED
}

enum DeliveryState {
  READY
  ATTEMPTING
  UNCERTAIN
  DONE
}

// Minimal safeguards retained after permanent message-history deletion.
model DeliveryReceipt {
  deliveryKey    String?  @unique
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId         String
  recipientEmail String
  createdAt      DateTime
  sentAt         DateTime
  user           User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, sentAt])
  @@index([userId, recipientEmail])
}

enum Plan {
  FREE
  PAID
}

enum SubscriptionStatus {
  NONE
  PENDING
  ACTIVE
  PAST_DUE
  ON_HOLD
  CANCELLED
  EXPIRED
  FAILED
  PAUSED
}

model BillingSubscription {
  id                   String             @id @default(uuid())
  userId               String?
  ownerIdSnapshot      String?
  dodoSubscriptionId   String             @unique
  dodoCustomerId       String
  productId            String
  status               SubscriptionStatus
  periodStart          DateTime?
  periodEnd            DateTime?
  gracePeriodEnd       DateTime?
  cancelAtPeriodEnd    Boolean            @default(false)
  cancelRequestedAt    DateTime?
  currency             String?
  billingCountry       String?
  recurringAmountMinor Int?
  lastEventAt          DateTime?
  settledPaymentId     String?
  paymentConfirmedAt   DateTime?
  createdAt            DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime           @updatedAt
  user                 User?              @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([status, periodEnd])
}

model CheckoutAttempt {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId          String?
  ownerIdSnapshot String?
  idempotencyKey  String
  productId       String
  billingCountry  String?
  billingCurrency String?
  dodoSessionId   String?  @unique
  checkoutUrl     String?
  failureCode     String?
  status          String   @default("CREATING")
  expiresAt       DateTime
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @default(now()) @updatedAt
  user            User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([userId, idempotencyKey])
  @@index([userId, status, expiresAt])
}

model BillingWebhookEvent {
  id                String    @id @default(uuid())
  webhookId         String    @unique
  eventType         String
  businessId        String
  subscriptionId    String?
  customerId        String?
  paymentId         String?
  occurredAt        DateTime
  receivedAt        DateTime  @default(now())
  processedAt       DateTime?
  nextAttemptAt     DateTime?
  attempts          Int       @default(0)
  processingVersion Int       @default(1)
  state             String    @default("RECEIVED")
  normalizedData    Json
  payloadHash       String
  failureCode       String?

  @@index([state, nextAttemptAt, receivedAt])
  @@index([processedAt, receivedAt, id])
  @@index([subscriptionId, occurredAt])
  @@index([customerId, occurredAt])
}

model AdminAuditLog {
  id               String   @id @default(uuid())
  actorUserId      String?
  targetUserId     String?
  actorIdSnapshot  String
  targetIdSnapshot String?
  action           String
  requestId        String   @unique
  requestHash      String?
  reason           String
  before           Json
  after            Json
  createdAt        DateTime @default(now())
  actor            User?    @relation("AdminActor", fields: [actorUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  target           User?    @relation("AdminTarget", fields: [targetUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([targetUserId, createdAt])
  @@index([actorUserId, createdAt])
  @@index([action, createdAt])
}

model SystemControl {
  id                     String    @id @default(uuid())
  key                    String    @unique
  gmailProjectPauseUntil DateTime?
  sendingEnabled         Boolean   @default(true)
  paidGatingEnabled      Boolean   @default(false)
  usageCutoverAt         DateTime?
  billingCheckoutEnabled Boolean   @default(false)
  dodoEnvironment        String?
  dodoBusinessId         String?
  updatedAt              DateTime  @updatedAt
}

// Period identity is independent of the current plan's allowance. Daily buckets
// and calendar-month buckets are shared when the effective plan changes.
enum UsagePeriodKind {
  DAILY
  MONTHLY
}

enum ReservationStatus {
  RESERVED
  ATTEMPTING
  UNCERTAIN
  CONFIRMED
  RELEASED
}

model UsagePeriod {
  id                  String             @id @default(uuid())
  userId              String
  key                 String
  kind                UsagePeriodKind
  startsAt            DateTime
  endsAt              DateTime
  operationalEndsAt   DateTime
  sent                Int                @default(0)
  reserved            Int                @default(0)
  importedSent        Int                @default(0)
  importedReserved    Int                @default(0)
  createdAt           DateTime           @default(now())
  user                User               @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  dailyReservations   UsageReservation[] @relation("DailyUsage")
  monthlyReservations UsageReservation[] @relation("MonthlyUsage")

  @@unique([userId, key])
  @@unique([id, userId])
  @@index([userId, kind, startsAt, operationalEndsAt])
}

model UsageReservation {
  id              String            @id @default(uuid())
  userId          String
  deliveryKey     String            @unique
  sendId          String?           @unique
  dailyPeriodId   String
  monthlyPeriodId String
  status          ReservationStatus @default(RESERVED)
  chargedAt       DateTime?
  confirmedAt     DateTime?
  releasedAt      DateTime?
  claimToken      String?
  leaseExpiresAt  DateTime?
  createdAt       DateTime          @default(now())
  user            User              @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  send            Send?             @relation(fields: [sendId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  dailyPeriod     UsagePeriod       @relation("DailyUsage", fields: [dailyPeriodId, userId], references: [id, userId], onDelete: Restrict)
  monthlyPeriod   UsagePeriod       @relation("MonthlyUsage", fields: [monthlyPeriodId, userId], references: [id, userId], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@index([userId, status, chargedAt])
  @@index([userId, dailyPeriodId, status])
  @@index([userId, monthlyPeriodId, status])
  @@index([status, leaseExpiresAt])
}

// No addresses or message content. Stable identity survives Send/Receipt deletion.
model UsageImportEvidence {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId          String
  sourceKey       String
  deliveryKey     String?  @unique
  chargedAt       DateTime
  timestampSource String
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  user            User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, sourceKey])
  @@index([userId, chargedAt])
}

model BillingRateLimit {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId       String
  operation    String
  minuteBucket DateTime
  requestCount Int      @default(1)
  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, operation, minuteBucket])
  @@index([minuteBucket])
}


enum GmailPauseReason {
  RECONNECT_REQUIRED
  OWNER_THROTTLE
  PROVIDER_DAILY_LIMIT
  DOMAIN_POLICY
}

model RateLimitBucket {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  scope         String
  operation     String
  admissions    DateTime[] @default([])
  cleanupAt     DateTime
  @@unique([scope, operation])
  @@index([cleanupAt])
}
